name: Gremlin Lice
text:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger A creature touches you, such as by hitting you with an unarmed attack, successfully Grappling you, or using a touch-range spell against you

---
Effect Some of the lice infesting you jump to your attacker. The triggering creature must succeed at a Reflex save save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or become Stupefied 1 as lice distract it (Stupefied 2 on a critical failure). The creature can use an Interact action to scratch itself to suppress the stupefied condition from the lice for 1 round. The infestation ends after 24 hours or if the creature is fully submerged in water or exposed to a severe cold environment, whichever happens first.
